root_cause.text: Missing release of the per-CPU pgmap reference (percpu_ref_put) in p2pmem_alloc_mmap() when vm_insert_page() fails, causing a reference leak that prevents memunmap_pages() from completing.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `percpu_ref_put(ref);` in the error path after `gen_pool_free()` inside the `if (ret)` block of `p2pmem_alloc_mmap()`. The CVE description states that without this fix, `memunmap_pages()` will hang forever when trying to remove the PCI device.

bic_trace_step.reason: In p2pmem_alloc_mmap(), after taking a reference with percpu_ref_tryget_live_rcu(ref), the function loops over pages and calls vm_insert_page(). If vm_insert_page() fails, the error path (lines after the loop's if (ret)) calls gen_pool_free() and returns without releasing the reference (percpu_ref_put(ref)).
